title: B2B Company Job Scraper & Hiring Signals Input

companies.title: Company Domains or ATS Slugs
companies.description: List of company domains (e.g. ['stripe.com', 'figma.com', 'linear.app']) or ATS board slugs (e.g. ['stripe', 'palantir', 'linear'])

company.title: Single Company Domain or Slug
company.description: Single company domain or ATS board slug for fast Standby execution (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'palantir')

keyword.title: Role or Tech Keyword Filter
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter to filter jobs by title (e.g. 'Engineer', 'Sales', 'Python', 'AI')

remoteOnly.title: Remote Roles Only
remoteOnly.description: If enabled, only returns positions marked as Remote

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max Jobs Per Company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per company (default: 50, 0 for unlimited)
